svg.title: Skills
svg.desc: Backend, frontend, data, testing, AI workflows, AI-assisted project technologies, hosting and creative skills. Skills. Backend & APIs PHP · Yii · REST · OpenAPI Backend logic, API integrations and data synchronisation. Frontend Vue · JavaScript · HTML · CSS Web interfaces and Vue components. Data MySQL · MariaDB · SQLite Complex SQL, database design and query optimisation. Testing & quality Cypress · Playwright · Vitest End-to-end, unit and regression tests. Visual and accessibility checks. AI workflows Codex · Claude Code · MCP Custom skills, agents, hooks and plugins. AI-assisted project stack React · TypeScript · Next.js · tRPC Node.js / Express, Electron, Vite, Tailwind CSS and Three.js / WebGL / GLSL. Hosting & tooling Linux · nginx · Docker · Git · GitHub Actions Self-hosting and nginx configuration. Practical basics in Git and Docker. Design & media Photography · Lightroom · Photoshop Graphic and web design, photo editing and video editing with DaVinci Resolve. Also Canva and GIMP.
